Self.Wiki: This map object represents an in-game object of varying sizes, from clutter to cliffs. Supports in-built collision, however not all objects use it.

Unk00.Wiki: Read by the game. ON for about 200 assets in the game files.

CollisionTypeOverride.Wiki: Overrides the asset geometry param Collision Type: 11 to 16 use that type, 0 uses the param's.

Unk04.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 for none. Where set it is usually the Break Item Lot ID + 500, so probably a second item lot.

Unk10.Wiki: Read by the game. In Elden Ring, a condition on a flag of the owning object: 0 always, 1 only when set, 2 only when not set, 3 never. 1 or 3 on a few assets.

Unk11.Wiki: Read by the game. In Elden Ring, this makes adjacent assets break together with this one. ON for 68 assets.

Unk14.Wiki: Read by the game. 0 except on 15 assets (1, 6, 8, 23 or 25).

AssetSfxParamRelativeID.Wiki: The SFX ID for this object to use (added to the base ModelSfxParam ID).

PickUpItemLotParamID.Wiki: The item lot given when the asset is picked up.

BreakItemLotParamID.Wiki: The item lot given when the asset is broken.

Unk58.Wiki: Read by the game. Smithbox's Map Animation tool reads it as the asset's pose. -1 on most assets.

PartName1.Wiki: A map object linked to this asset. Set on one asset in the game files.

PartName2.Wiki: A collision linked to this asset.

PartName3.Wiki: A collision linked to this asset.

PartName4.Wiki: The collision whose settings the asset uses when Part Name: 5 is empty (see the Override settings below).

PartName5.Wiki: The collision whose settings the asset uses (see the Override settings below). Must be a collision.

PartName6.Wiki: An asset linked to this asset.

CollisionSettings.Wiki: The asset's own copy of collision settings. When Override Collision Settings is ON these are used, otherwise those of the collision in Part Name: 5 (or 4).

OverrideCollisionSettings.Wiki: If ON, the asset uses the collision settings below instead of those of its collision.

CollisionSettings_Unk04.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x26.

CollisionSettings_Unk14.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x3C.

LocationTextID.Wiki: The asset's own Location Text ID: the place name shown when stepping onto it.

CollisionSettings_Unk28.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x1C.

PlayRegionID.Wiki: The asset's own Play Region ID.

InnerStruct70.Wiki: Unknown settings read by the game.

UnkStruct70_Unk04.Wiki: Read by the game. -1, or 100 on about 5,400 assets.

UnkStruct70_Unk14.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 in the game files.

UnkStruct70_Unk1C.Wiki: Read by the game. -1, or 4 on about 2,800 assets.

GparamSettings.Wiki: The asset's own copy of collision gparam and light settings. When Override Gparam Settings is ON these are used, otherwise those of the collision in Part Name: 5 (or 4).

OverrideCollisionGparamSettings.Wiki: If ON, the asset uses the gparam settings below instead of those of its collision.

GparamSettings_Unk04.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x4.

GparamOverride.Wiki: The asset's own Gparam Override: a gparam sub ID that replaces BB in mXX_XX_AABB. -1 for none.

GparamSettings_Unk0A.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x34.

GparamSettings_Unk0B.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: Scene Gparam 0x1D.

GparamSettings_Unk0C.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: Scene Gparam 0x20 (a gparam sub ID).

GparamSettings_Unk0E.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x4C.

TimezonePlayerLightScaleOverride.Wiki: The asset's own Timezone Player Light Scale Override: 1 on, 2 off, 0 keeps the map's value.

SoundSettings.Wiki: The asset's own copy of collision sound settings. When Override Sound Settings is ON these are used, otherwise those of the collision in Part Name: 5 (or 4).

OverrideCollisionSoundSettings.Wiki: If ON, the asset uses the sound settings below instead of those of its collision.

OutdoorIndoorType.Wiki: The asset's own sound space while standing on it: 0 outdoor, 1 half indoor, 2 fully indoor. -1 keeps the default.

EasyOcclusionID.Wiki: The asset's own Easy Occlusion ID (sound occlusion state) while standing on it.
